Contract identity and initial foundation coordination

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

Record R102 Date 2026-08-04 Meeting minutes

Attendees: Fictional Project Architect, Structural Engineer, Procurement Officer and Quantity Surveyor. Recorder: Fictional Quantity Surveyor.

We confirmed Contract No. 20260983, Construction of Youth and Elderly Centre at Sha Tin Area 34. The centre includes a domestic residential accommodation block for resident staff. All buildings are in Sha Tin; there are no works in Tin Shui Wai.

Foundation works and building works are included in this combined contract. The Contractor designs and constructs the driven piling for the centre. The Architect designs the pile caps and the shallow footings, which the Contractor constructs.

This initial coordination covers piling, pilecaps and footings only. It is not a complete schedule of components, and the actual work limits will be supplied in the detailed responsibility reply. The three initial entries are:
Component | Contractor designs | Contractor executes
piling | Yes | Yes
pilecaps | No | Yes
footings | No | Yes

Complete component responsibilities and tender submissions

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

Record R107 Date 2026-08-11 Email reply

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>
To: Fictional Coordination Team <team@consense-scenario.invalid>

This is the complete component responsibility schedule, including the boundary retaining walls omitted from the initial coordination. It supplies the work limits for the earlier three entries and does not change their design or execution assignments.
Component | Actual work scope | Contractor executes | Contractor designs
piling | Driven steel piles for the youth wing | Yes | Yes
pilecaps | Architect designed pile caps for the youth wing | Yes | No
footings | Shallow footings for the elderly wing and covered entrance | Yes | No
other | Architect designed retaining walls along the eastern boundary | Yes | No

The shallow footings serve the elderly wing building and the covered entrance, which is a major external structure.

The Contractor must submit its proposed piling foundation design with the Tender. The final foundation design is not established at tender acceptance; it remains subject to subsequent checking and approval.

RSE endorsed submissions are not required for this project. The additional tender submissions are:
Submit an accessible pedestrian diversion plan with the Tender.
Submit a vibration monitoring proposal for the neighbouring care home with the Tender.

The question whether a design related quotation must be obtained before a Variation is instructed remains open. This reply records neither adoption nor rejection of that optional requirement.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor

Fictional Quantity Surveyor
